content: {"episode_id":"ep-05110","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring, which was denied for absent precertification. The clinical indication documents recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and near-syncope (R55), raising concern for intermittent arrhythmia. Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73), prolonged mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptoms with potential cardiac rhythm disturbances. We request review of this supporting clinical documentation and payment of the outstanding balance of 903.86."}
